## What Was Requested

Task 2: Remove model field, fix constructors, simplify template, write migration

Requirements:
1. Remove `requires_explanation: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(default=False)` from `app/models/tracking.py` (was line 82)

6. Run `alembic upgrade head` — completes cleanly.
7. `pytest tests/test_flashcards.py -v` — all pass including the two new regression tests.
8. `pytest --tb=short -q` — all pass, no regressions.
9. Everything committed in one commit.
